summary: All 11 Lean files in the BooleanAnalysis/PolynomialCorrelation directory contain substantial formal mathematical content — definitions, lemmas, theorems, and proofs formalizing the exponential correlation bounds for polynomials from Chattopadhyay, Hatami, Lee, Lovett, Tal, and Viola (2026). The main file (PolynomialCorrelation.lean) exposes the public API including Theorem 1.1 (xorMajority_correlation_le). Defs.lean provides core definitions (monomials, lowSpan, BlockCube, majority, correlation, filtration). The Internal/ directory contains the proof machinery: interpolation on downsets (Interpolation.lean), block product spanning (Blocks.lean), filtration and multiplication lemmas (Filtration.lean, Multiplication.lean), counting arguments via involutive toggle (Counting.lean), reduction on agreement sets (Reduction.lean), finite correlation bound (FiniteBound.lean), and binomial/square-root estimates (Binomial.lean). Bridge.lean connects the two input representations and derives the final bounds. Every file contains executable Lean 4 code with mathematical statements and proofs; none are pure import aggregators or documentation-only.
